messages:
Priya (SRE): Heads-up: spikes in 5xx and p95 timeouts reported for hosted/inference across eu-west-1 since ~11:03 UTC. Customer escalations coming in. Opening war room now.
Jamal (Support): seeing a bunch of customer tickets referencing 504s on long-gen requests, some on shorter ones too. Customers A & C reported within last 15m.
infra-bot: Deploy monitor alerted: gateway-retries > 250/s and backend 504-rate = 8.7% for model-serving-prod-eu-west (rolling avg 5m).
Evelyn (Eng-Platform): I'm pulling metrics. Early look: batcher queue depth spiked, and a subset of GPU pods are hitting OOM+restarts around the same time. Suspect batching configuration change yesterday evening.
Owen (Customer Success): Can we provide customers a quick note? They want ETA and mitigation plan.
Priya (SRE): Mitigations in motion: 1) set gateway circuit breaker to fail-fast for model-serving-prod-eu-west, 2) scale down max-batch-size from 128 -> 64 on suspect model groups, 3) route traffic to fallback-ssm smaller model for heavy requests. Applying now.
Evelyn (Eng-Platform): Rolling the batch-size change to canary group now: kubectl patch deployment model-batcher-eu --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"batch-size-rollout":"canary-1714529000"}}}}}'
Priya (SRE): Gateways updated: fail-fast enabled, timeout lowered to 15s for risky routes. Observability hooks added to capture per-request queue wait time.
Jamal (Support): Posted initial customer comms: "We're investigating increased 5xx/timeout errors in EU. Mitigations underway; we'll update in 30 minutes." (customers pinged: A,C,E) :thumbsup:
Evelyn (Eng-Platform): Canary shows immediate drop in queue depth on those pods, OOMs stopped on canary. Rolling to 50% now.
Priya (SRE): After routing fallback and batch change, overall 5xx dropped from 8.7% -> 1.9% in 12 minutes. Still seeing tail errors for very long requests.
Owen (Customer Success): Noted — A acknowledged the update and reduced alerting on their side.
Priya (SRE): Quick repro log snippet from worker pod (truncated):
```
2024-03-01T11:02:41Z ERROR inference: kv-cache stall after 1200ms; enqueue wait=310ms; alloc_failure: out_of_memory
2024-03-01T11:03:09Z WARN batcher: batch_size=120 forced; retrying request backoff=200ms
2024-03-01T11:03:17Z ERROR gateway: upstream timeout after 30s
```
Evelyn (Eng-Platform): Looks like large batches + memory pressure causing GC/alloc spikes. Action: add memory headroom by reducing default max-batch-size and enable token-prefill caching for long-prefix requests.
Priya (SRE): Immediate action items (short):
- Priya: keep circuit breaker active for 1h and monitor, rollback if customer impact increases.
- Evelyn: finalize batch-size rollback and push optimized config to all eu pools (ETA 40m).
- Jamal: update customers with mitigation + timeline, escalate to account teams where needed.
- Owen: collect affected customer request IDs and share with eng for replay.
Priya (SRE): Long-term actions (to track in postmortem):
- Add canary test that simulates sustained high batch-queue depth + memory footprint.
- Improve autoscaling policy for batcher pods based on queue length and memory.
- Add guardrail to prevent large-models from defaulting to max-batch-size=128 for long-context requests.
- Run eval on model quantization/alloc pattern for memory-heavy models.
Jamal (Support): I'll open a consolidated support ticket with affected customers and attach sample request IDs.
Evelyn (Eng-Platform): Quick note: patch deployed to all eu-west pools at 11:18 UTC. Observability shows p95 latency down ~35% and 5xx < 2%.
Priya (SRE): Closing war room in 30m if no regression. We'll publish a short postmortem draft tomorrow with root cause + actions. Please add any additional notes to the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/inbox/incidents/1714529000 (will be updated).
Owen (Customer Success): Thanks team — customers appreciated the quick response.
Jamal (Support): Follow-up: open task for Customer Success to run through SLA credits checklist if any customers request it.
infra-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Metrics link: https://observability.redwood/graphs/1714529000
Priya (SRE): Last check: no new OOMs in last 30m and retries stayed low. Moving to monitoring state. Will reconvene if noise returns. :white_check_mark:
